SELECT

    MIN(business_date) as trading_start_date,
    MAX(business_date) as trading_end_date,
    index_ticker,
    index_series as series,
    index_version as version,
    index_tenor as tenor
FROM market.markit_credit_index_pricing
WHERE
    1=1
    AND composite_spread is not null
    AND index_ticker in ('CDXNAIG')
    AND index_tenor in ('5Y')
    AND on_the_run = 'Y'
    AND batch in ('LN1600')
GROUP BY
    index_red_code, index_ticker, index_series, index_version, index_tenor
ORDER BY
    index_series ASC, index_version ASC

                        ist.level_2_nodename as "department",
                        ist.level_3_nodename as "signal",
                        ist.level_4_nodename as "invgroup",
                        
                        mh.abor_security_name,
                        mh.abor_instrument_type,
                        mh.abor_security_type_name,
                        mh.abor_country_of_security,
                        mh.abor_country_of_exposure_name,
                       
                        mh.abor_maturity_date,
                        s.abor_coupon_rate,
                        s.isin_id,
                        s.cusip_id,
                        s.bb_global_id,
                        
                        CASE
                            WHEN s.abor_quote_type IS NULL THEN 'Per unit'
                            ELSE s.abor_quote_type
                        END as "abor_quote_type",

                        CASE
                            WHEN s.abor_quote_factor IS NULL THEN 1
                            ELSE s.abor_quote_factor
                        END as "abor_quote_factor",

                        mh.balance_nominal_number,

                        mh.clean_price,
                        mh.dirty_price,

                        --PC == reporting_currency == CAD
                        --QC == quotation_currency == Local

                        CASE
                            WHEN mh.abor_instrument_type = 'Cash bucket' THEN mh.clean_value_quotation_currency
                            ELSE mh.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency
                        END as "balance_cost_local",
                        mh.clean_value_quotation_currency as "clean_value_local",
                        CASE
                            WHEN mh.abor_instrument_type = 'Cash bucket' THEN 0
                            ELSE mh.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency + mh.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency + mh.next_dividend_quotation_currency + mh.next_coupon_quotation_currency + mh.accrued_interest_quotation_currency
                        END as "total_accrual_local",
                        CASE
                            WHEN mh.abor_instrument_type = 'Cash bucket' THEN mh.clean_value_quotation_currency

                            WHEN mh.abor_instrument_type = 'Cash bucket' THEN 0
                            ELSE mh.long_settlement_correction_value_portfolio_currency + mh.balance_expected_restitution_portfolio_currency + mh.next_dividend_portfolio_currency + mh.next_coupon_portfolio_currency + mh.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency

                            WHEN mh.abor_instrument_type = 'Cash bucket' THEN mh.clean_value_portfolio_currency
                            ELSE mh.clean_value_portfolio_currency + mh.long_settlement_correction_value_portfolio_currency + mh.balance_expected_restitution_portfolio_currency + mh.next_dividend_portfolio_currency + mh.next_coupon_portfolio_currency + mh.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency
                        END as "total_mtm_cad",
                       
                        mh.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as fx_rate,
                        
                        s.reporting_id_name,
                        party.cppib_party_id,
                        p.party_name as issuer_name,
                        p.ticker as issuer_ticker,
                        class.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as issuer_gics_sector,
                        class.cppib_sector_classification_name_2 as issuer_gics_industry_group,
                        class.cppib_sector_classification_name_3 as issuer_gics_industry,
                        class.cppib_sector_classification_name_4 as issuer_gics_subindustry

                    from holdings.scd_holdings_main mh
                    left join asset_uat.asset_security_party_relationship party on CAST(party.cppib_sec_id as int) = CAST(mh.cppib_sec_id as int) and party.business_date = Date('2025-06-03') and role = 'ISSUER'
                    left join reference.scd_securities s on s.abor_security_number = mh.abor_security_number and s.business_date = '2025-06-03'
                    left join finance_accounting.v_investment_structure ist on mh.model_portfolio_id = ist.id_model_portfolio and ist.business_date = date('2025-06-03') 
                    left join party_uat.party p on cast(p.cppib_party_id as int) = cast(party.cppib_party_id as int) and p.business_date = Date('2025-06-03')
                    left join party_uat.party_enterprise_classification class on cast(p.cppib_party_id as int) = cast(class.cppib_party_id as int) and class.business_date = Date('2025-06-03')
                    where mh.business_date = '2025-06-03' and ist.level_2_nodename = 'Credit Investments'

                ), security_ratings as (
                    select
                        cppib_sec_id, 
                        type, 
                        sub_type, 
                        rating_agency, 
                        rating_date, 
                        cppib_party_id, 
                        rating_value, 
                        adj_lgd, 
                        business_date, 
                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                            PARTITION BY cppib_sec_id, rating_agency
                            ORDER BY business_date DESC
                        ) AS rn
                    FROM performance.cppib_security_rating_pit
                    WHERE active = 'Y'               
                ), issuer_ratings as (
                    select
                        cppib_party_id, 
                        type, 
                        rating_type, 
                        rating_agency, 
                        rating_value, 
                        business_date, 
                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                            PARTITION BY cppib_party_id, rating_agency
                        ) AS rn
                    FROM performance.cppib_party_rating_pit 
                    WHERE active='Y'
                )

                select 
                    h.*,
                    sr.rating_date as security_rating_date, 
                    sr.rating_value as security_rating_value,
                    ir.rating_value as issuer_rating_value

                FROM holdings h
                left join security_ratings sr on CAST(h.cppib_sec_id as int) = CAST(sr.cppib_sec_id as int) and sr.rn = 1 and sr.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
                left join issuer_ratings ir on h.cppib_party_id = ir.cppib_party_id and ir.rn = 1 and ir.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'

                order by invgroup

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )

WITH holdings_view AS (

        asset.business_date,
        perf.InvestmentStructureLevel2,
        perf.InvestmentStructureLevel3,
        asset.issuer_name,
        holdings.market_value_pc_amount,
        asset.country_of_exposure_code,

        asset.gics_industry_name,
        asset.gics_sub_industry_name,

        asset.sub_industry_name
    FROM
        asset.asset_instrument_classifications_latest_ex_epm AS asset

        holdings.id_model_portfolio = perf.model_portfolio

)

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
	adjusted_date AS (
		SELECT
			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT

        SELECT

              AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')

/* cppi::02a94d974c53dcacef8d508209ba60072be21babf19312fd79559901b70c51b5 */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-26')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-26')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-05-26')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

/* cppi::e2f0978fad656737798a7149d89ce7df132061496f604ff46079a6a6019a625f */
WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_prod
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='BCPP' and sd.business_date = dh.business_date

where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-06-03'
    )
select ule.party_name,
       ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure)                                 as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit as single_name_limit,
       case
           when ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit > 0 then round(sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) *
                                                                100, 1)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit)
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure f
         join radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity le on f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = le.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and f.business_date = le.business_date
         join radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity ule on le.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = ule.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit is not null and ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit != -1 and f.business_date = ule.business_date

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date
where f.bcpp_credit_exposure is not null
  and f.business_date = '2025-06-03'
group by ule.party_name, ule.gics_sector, ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit, pv.analytic_value
order by sum(bcpp_credit_exposure) desc

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]

			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

	WHERE

		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[

/* cppi::bb0a261d63d1c11e0de2fc661d19b9d81197172e1f4bcf094447a1bbfc426458 */
SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%0'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_company c ON f.company_id = c.companyid
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND s.primaryFlag=1
                    AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                    AND f.pit_date = '2025-06-04'
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%0'
                )
            WHERE period_end_date = maxperiodenddate AND
                fiscal_chain_id = maxfiscalchainid AND
                capiq_item IS NOT NULL
            ) AS cf
            ON ctev.companyid = cf.company_id
            LEFT JOIN
            (select company_id, company_name, investor_id, investor_name, period_end_date,
                    percent_of_shares_outstanding, rank_of_shares_held
            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,
                        o.owner_object_id as investor_id,
                        i.companyname as investor_name, o.period_end_date,
                        o.percent_of_shares_outstanding,
                        o.rank_of_shares_held,
                        max(period_end_date) over (partition by o.company_id)
                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid
                where pit_date_str = '2025-06-04'
                    and o.is_latest_flag = 1
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held <6
                    AND c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%0'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci
            ON ctev.companyid = ci.company_id

-- Get latest business date data that is available in both tables
    WITH max_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten i
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio m
            WHERE i.business_date = m.business_date
            -- business_date field in scd_performance_invstr_flatten is a string
            )
    ),
    -- Get the latest investment structure name that starts with 'CPPIB_F'.  As of 2025-04-25, the latest is CPPIB_F24
    latest_investment_structure AS (
        SELECT MAX( InvestmentStructure ) latest_investment_structure_name
        FROM max_business_date d
        JOIN performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten i
            ON i.business_date = d.business_date
            AND InvestmentStructure LIKE 'CPPIB_F%%'
    )
    SELECT 
        i.model_portfolio model_portfolio_code,
        i.model_portfolio_name,
        investmentstructurelevel1 investment_structure_level_01,
        investmentstructurelevel2 investment_structure_level_02,
        investmentstructurelevel3 investment_structure_level_03,
        investmentstructurelevel4 investment_structure_level_04,
        investmentstructurelevel5 investment_structure_level_05,
        investmentstructurelevel6 investment_structure_level_06,
        investmentstructurelevel7 investment_structure_level_07,
        pool_account_code core_supp,
        investment_strategy_name,
        investmentstructure investment_structure_name
    FROM max_business_date d
    JOIN latest_investment_structure l on 1 = 1
    JOIN performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten i
        ON i.business_date = d.business_date
        AND investmentstructure = l.latest_investment_structure_name
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio m
        ON m.business_date = d.business_date
        AND m.model_portfolio_id = i.model_portfolio

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 02 and 03
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 02:13:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
	h.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency,

    s.abor_issuer_id,

    pr.rating_value as cppib_party_rating
from 
	(select * from holdings.scd_holdings_main where business_date = '2025-03-31' and portfolio_id!='LOOK THRU') h
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT * 
     FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten 
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) 
                            FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
       AND investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24') mp
    ON h.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT * 
     FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio 
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) 
                            FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)) mport

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-28')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-28')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",

        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'

          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('MPINLCP1D','MINEON9','MINADP9','MINDNY9','MINCLNX','MINELET')

/* cppi::58a8c159263775f6a7e836a29153f30346e711ba1a79a4efc75dc69954cd1324 */
with today as (
    SELECT
    business_date,
    model_portfolio_id,
    abor_security_id,
    SUM(market_value_reporting_currency) AS total_market_value
  FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation 
  GROUP BY
    business_date,
    model_portfolio_id,
    abor_security_id
),
yesterday as(SELECT
    business_date,
    model_portfolio_id,
    abor_security_id,
    SUM(market_value_reporting_currency) AS total_market_value
  FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation
  GROUP BY
    business_date,
    model_portfolio_id,
    abor_security_id
),
dmv as(
  SELECT
    t.business_date                           AS bs,
    t.model_portfolio_id,
    t.abor_security_id                        AS secid,
    t.total_market_value                      AS mv_today,
    y.total_market_value                      AS mv_yesterday,
    (t.total_market_value - coalesce(y.total_market_value,0)) AS mv_change
  FROM today AS t
  LEFT JOIN yesterday AS y
    ON y.model_portfolio_id = t.model_portfolio_id
   AND y.abor_security_id   = t.abor_security_id
   AND DATE_PARSE(y.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
       = DATE_ADD('day', -1, DATE_PARSE(t.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
)
select
s.abor_instrument_type_id as "Instrument Type Name - Current",
s.abor_security_type_name as "Security Type Name - Current",
mp.model_portfolio_id as "Model Portfolio Code",
mp.model_portfolio_name as "Model Portfolio Name",
s.abor_security_name_id as "Security Name - Current",
psl.aggregation_level_3 as "Security ID - Current",
esm.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code as "Currency of Exposure Code - Current",
psl.business_date as "Frequency Period",
p.party_name as "Issuer Name - Current",
esm.underlying_instrument_isin  as "Underlying ISIN 1 - Current",
'Not Applicable' as "Start Date",
psl.business_date as "End Date",
dmv.mv_change,
psl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency as "Net Cash Flow PC",
pa.fxpnl AS "Fx PnL PC",
pa.secpnl as "Security PnL PC",
pa.totpnl as "Total PnL PC"
from
performance.scd_performance_seclvl psl
left join reference.scd_securities s on s.abor_security_id =psl.aggregation_level_3  and s.business_date =psl.business_date
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp on psl.aggregation_level_1 = mp.model_portfolio_id and mp.business_date = psl.business_date
left join asset.asset_security_identifiers asi on cast(s.cppib_sec_id as int) = asi.cppib_sec_id and asi.business_date = date(s.business_date)
left join party.party p on asi.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id and p.business_date = asi.business_date
LEFT JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            model_portfolio_code,
            security_no,
            security_id,
            business_date,
            currency,
            SUM(pnl_currency_exposure_fx) AS fxpnl,
            sum(pnl_local_exposure_fx) as secpnl,
            sum(pnl_cad) as totpnl
        FROM 
            performance.pace_holding_pnl
        GROUP BY 
            model_portfolio_code,
            security_no,
            security_id,
            business_date, 
            currency
    ) pa 
on psl.aggregation_level_3 = pa.security_id
	and psl.aggregation_level_1 =pa.model_portfolio_code
	and date(psl.business_date) = pa.business_date
	and psl.aggregation_level_2 =pa.currency   
LEFT JOIN 
    asset.enterprise_security_composite esm
    ON psl.aggregation_level_3 = esm.abor_security_id 
    AND DATE(psl.business_date) = esm.business_date
left join dmv on dmv.bs=psl.business_date and dmv.secid=psl.aggregation_level_3
where s.abor_instrument_type_id = 'Securities lending'
and psl.business_date between '2025-03-01' and '2025-03-31'
--and psl.aggregation_level_3 ='IRS5607812'
ORDER BY
  psl.aggregation_level_1,
  psl.aggregation_level_3,
  DATE_PARSE(psl.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
